summary: Lookout listed on the statewide Georgia list in Henry County at 982 feet; no source found gives its history, fate or condition.

visit.trail_note: No source describes the Nix site today, including what remains there or whether the public can reach it.

evidence.supports: nix listed in Henry County at 982 ft, with coordinates 33.42134, -84.26518
March 1954 Georgia Forestry issue (reprinted Atlanta Constitution article): Henry County forestry unit had three lookout towers available in 1953
evidence.quote: In 1953 three lookout towers were available for the unit's use.

evidence.supports: tower operator or pilot reports smoke by two-way FM radio to the dispatcher
evidence.quote: make their report via two-way FM radio to the dispatcher.

evidence.quote: The dispatcher, in turn, sends a suppression crew to the wildfire site

notes_for_editor: Only the statewide list entry names Nix. Two web searches and the cached NHLR Georgia index found no Nix history; NHLR's index does not list it. The March 1954 Georgia Forestry issue, reprinting an Atlanta Constitution article, says three Henry County towers were available in 1953 but names none, so it is county background and is not tied to Nix in the story. The DLG text has no mention of Nix. Possible lead for a human to check, unconfirmed: the Eastern US Lookouts Georgia page has an unnamed Henry County entry reporting that a 100-foot Aermotor MC-40 was sold in 2012 and would be relocated to Reynolds Nature Preserve near Morrow. Nothing links it to Nix. Brief's status unknown and access unknown are unchanged.
